_meta.purpose: Structured class->spell index for rippers-compendium. Feeds a future PACK 4 in build-compendium.mjs that emits type:'spell' Items (same snapshot-driven pattern as classes/skills/heroics). Consumed by rippers-guise spell auto-materialization (Austin ruling: binding a spellcasting guise auto-stamps its class spells onto the actor).
_meta.output_shape: OPTION B — a spells[] + class_spells[] table in the db-snapshot shape. Fold these two keys into data/db-snapshot.json (or read this file alongside it in build-compendium.mjs). Chosen over Option A (a hand-authored Item pack) because the whole build is already snapshot-driven: classes/class_skills/heroic_skills are data tables the tool compiles into Items, and spells slot in identically. No invented values — mpCost.value and target.value are FU StringFields, stored verbatim from the draft prose; duration.value mapped to the FU enum (instantaneous|scene|special); damage read only where the prose states (HR + N) <type>.
_meta.generated_by: Compiler (hive), 2026-09-04, from the seven DRAFT-spells-*.md + DRAFT-note-npc-spells.md + RULE-spell-mimic-cost.md. Local only, not published.
_meta.fu_field_paths: spell-data-model.mjs: mpCost.value (String), target.value (String), duration.value (enum), isOffensive.value (Boolean), rollInfo.damage.hasDamage.value / .type.value / .value (Number, HR added at cast), rollInfo.attributes.primary/secondary.value.

field_conventions.resource: MP for all disciplines EXCEPT sineater, which costs HP (Magic of the Craft) — FU spell mpCost assumes MP; see data_gaps.hp_cost_spells.
field_conventions.mpCost.value: verbatim printed cost string incl. per-target multiplier ('10 × T') and variable ('Up to 20 MP').
field_conventions.perTarget: true where the printed cost is 'N × T' (cost scales per target).
field_conventions.damage.value: the flat N in '(HR + N)'; FU adds the High Roll at cast. Omitted (hasDamage:false) where the spell deals no typed spell damage (status, heal, resource-loss, weapon-imbue, buff).
field_conventions.heroic: true where the draft marks the entry a Heroic-Skill spell, not a base discipline spell.
field_conventions.verbatim_effect: byte-faithful to the draft (which is itself verbatim-from-source with silent register rename); house-authored entries are flagged.

spells.name: Insulating Jacket
spells.effect: You weave magical energy and protect the targets from the fury of the elements. Choose a damage type: air, bolt, earth, fire or ice. Until this spell ends, each target gains Resistance to the chosen damage type.

spells.name: The Tarrant Glide
spells.effect: Until this spell ends, you treat your Dexterity as if it were one die size higher (up to a maximum of d12). At the end of the round, if you are under the effects of this spell, you must perform up to two free attacks, dealing extra damage equal to half your current Dexterity die size. If you perform only one attack, it gains multi (2); if you perform two attacks, both attacks follow the rules for two-weapon fighting (see Core Rulebook, page 69). This spell ends after all the attacks are resolved.

spells.name: The Fenwick Temper
spells.effect: You imbue a weapon with elemental energy. Choose a damage type: air, bolt, earth, fire, or ice. Until this spell ends, all damage dealt by the weapon becomes of the chosen damage type. If you have that weapon equipped while you cast this spell, you may perform a free attack with it as part of the same action. This spell can only be cast on a weapon equipped by a willing creature.

spells.name: Ballistic Extension
spells.effect: The wind carries your strikes across the battlefield. You may perform a free attack with a melee weapon you have equipped; this attack may target creatures that cannot normally be targeted by melee attacks. If you used a weapon belonging to the brawling, spear, or sword Category for this attack, it deals 5 extra damage. If you hit a flying target with this attack, you may force them to land immediately.

spells.name: Fulgur
spells.opportunity: each target hit by this spell suffers dazed
spells.effect: You weave electricity into a wave of crackling bolts. You deal (HR + 15) bolt damage to each target hit by this spell. Opportunity: each target hit by this spell suffers dazed.

spells.name: Glacies
spells.opportunity: each target hit by this spell suffers slow
spells.effect: You coat your foes under a thick layer of frost. You deal (HR + 15) ice damage to each target hit by this spell. Opportunity: each target hit by this spell suffers slow.

spells.name: Ignis
spells.opportunity: each target hit by this spell suffers shaken
spells.effect: You unleash a searing barrage against your foes, conjuring flames out of thin air. You deal (HR + 15) fire damage to each target hit by this spell. Opportunity: each target hit by this spell suffers shaken.

spells.name: Terra
spells.opportunity: each target hit by this spell performs one fewer action on their next turn (to a minimum of 0 actions)
spells.effect: Spires of jagged rock erupt from the ground beneath your foes, closing around them. You deal (HR + 15) earth damage to each target hit by this spell. This spell cannot target creatures that are flying, floating, falling, or otherwise in mid-air. Opportunity: each target hit by this spell performs one fewer action on their next turn (to a minimum of 0 actions).

spells.name: Ventus
spells.opportunity: each flying target hit by this spell is forced to land immediately
spells.effect: You summon the power of winds against your enemy. You deal (HR + 15) air damage to each target hit by this spell. Opportunity: each flying target hit by this spell is forced to land immediately.

spells.name: Concussion
spells.effect: You summon a colossal block of stone and send it straight towards your enemy. You deal (HR + 25) earth damage to the target; this damage ignores Resistances.

spells.name: Incandescence
spells.effect: You channel a single ray of fire towards your foe, its temperature so high that it will pierce through most defenses. You deal (HR + 25) fire damage to the target; this damage ignores Resistances.

spells.name: Congelation
spells.effect: A pillar of ice magic envelops your foe, dropping their temperature to critical levels. You deal (HR + 25) ice damage to the target; this damage ignores Resistances.

spells.name: Leyden Discharge
spells.effect: You send an arrow of overcharged lightning to strike your foe. You deal (HR + 25) bolt damage to the target; this damage ignores Resistances.

spells.name: Rarefaction
spells.effect: You slash through your foe with high-pressure wind. You deal (HR + 25) air damage to the target; this damage ignores Resistances.

spells.name: Pyroclastic Column

damage._gap: FIXED amount, not (HR+N): 50 fire to one enemy OR 30 fire to all enemies (+5 at L20, +10 at L40); ignores Resistances and Immunities. Single FU damage.value cannot represent the choose-scope fixed amounts — needs special handling.

spells.effect: You channel the fury of the planet into a powerful wave of fire and magma. Choose one option: you deal 50 fire damage to one enemy you can see; or you deal 30 fire damage to every enemy you can see. These amounts increase by 5 if you are level 20 or higher, or by 10 if you are level 40 or higher. Damage dealt by this spell ignores Resistances and Immunities.
flags: retype/rename permission NOT inlined: printed rules let the caster rename Volcano and change its damage to air/bolt/earth/ice (SPELLS-master-list §2C, five named register faces). Kept as printed fire/Pyroclastic Column — Austin's call whether the five faces appear.

spells.name: Effluvia
spells.effect: You manipulate the elemental balance within the target's body. You deal (HR + 30) poison damage to the target, and this damage ignores Resistances. Then, if the High Roll of the Magic Check was 8 or higher, or if you have acquired the Pathogenesis Skill (Core Rulebook, page 183), the target suffers poisoned.
spells.source: Playtest Materials (Miasma), granted by the Miasma/Effluvia heroic skill
flags: Magic-Check attribute choice (INS+WLP or MIG+WLP) lives on the granting heroic, not the spell box — not reproduced here.

spells.name: Ebon Lacquer
spells.effect: You imbue a weapon with dark energy. Until this spell ends, all damage dealt by the weapon becomes dark. If you have that weapon equipped while you cast this spell, you may perform a free attack with it as part of the same action. This spell can only be cast on a weapon equipped by a willing creature.

spells.name: Psychical Depletion

damage._note: MP loss, not typed damage: target loses (HR + 20) MP; caster recovers half.

spells.effect: You consume a creature's psyche. The target loses (HR + 20) Mind Points. Then, you recover an amount of Mind Points equal to half the total Mind Points loss they suffered (if the target had no MP left, you recover none).

spells.name: Dissolution
spells.effect: You cleanse all magic from a creature. The target stops being affected by all spells with a duration of "Scene" that are affecting them.

spells.name: Prognostic Survey
spells.effect: You briefly glimpse into the future. Until this spell ends, after a creature you can see rolls dice for a Check, if it is not a fumble or a critical success, you may force them to reroll both dice. Once you have forced two rerolls this way, this spell ends.

spells.name: The Bulstrode Transfer
spells.effect: You steal another creature's life force. You deal (HR + 15) dark damage to the target. Then, you recover an amount of Hit Points equal to half the total Hit Points loss they suffered (if the target had no HP left, you recover none).

spells.name: Specular Reversion
spells.effect: You twist the laws of magic. Until this spell ends, when the target is targeted by an offensive spell (O), the creature that cast that offensive spell will be targeted in their stead (any other targets of the offensive spell will be targeted as normal). Once that happens, this spell ends.

spells.name: Temporal Arrest
spells.effect: You trap a foe inside a circle of altered time and space. The target will perform one fewer action on their next turn (to a minimum of 0 actions).

spells.name: Umbral Extraction
spells.opportunity: each target hit by this spell suffers weak
spells.effect: A storm of dark energy turns matter into ash. You deal (HR + 15) dark damage to each target hit by this spell. Opportunity: each target hit by this spell suffers weak.

spells.name: Mortal Abatement

damage._note: Untyped HP loss, not damage: target loses (20 + half their level) HP.

spells.effect: You invoke doom on your foe, turning strength into frailty. The target loses an amount of Hit Points equal to (20 + half their level).

spells.name: Kinetic Augmentation
spells.effect: At the end of each of their turns, the target may choose one option: perform a free attack with a weapon they have equipped; or perform the Spell action for free, casting a spell with a total MP cost equal to or lower than 10 (paying its MP cost). After the same creature benefits from this effect a second time, this spell ends.

spells.name: Aberrant Susceptibility
spells.effect: You alter the very nature of your target. Until this spell ends, if the target would suffer damage of a type they Absorb or are Immune to, they are instead treated as if they were Vulnerable to that damage type. Once that happens, this spell ends.

spells.name: Aleatory Trial

damage._gap: RANDOM outcome + random type: on a 9 result, deal 30 damage to any number of creatures; on 9+, roll d6 for type (1=air,2=bolt,3=dark,4=earth,5=fire,6=poison). Damage type not fixed; whole spell is a Willpower-die outcome table. Needs special handling / macro.

spells.effect: You summon a vortex of chaotic energy. Roll your current Willpower die once for every 10 Mind Points spent while casting this spell, then keep the single die you prefer: the number on that die determines the effects of this spell. [1: Lose half current HP and MP] [2-3: Each creature present (including self) suffers poisoned] [4-6: Each creature present (including self) suffers slow] [7-8: Choose up to three creatures you can see — each recovers 50 HP and recovers from all status effects] [9: Choose any number of creatures you can see — deal 30 damage to each] [9+ damage type determined by rolling d6: 1=air, 2=bolt, 3=dark, 4=earth, 5=fire, 6=poison]

spells.name: The Perihelion

damage._gap: FIXED, TYPELESS: 60 to one enemy OR 40 to all (+5 L20, +10 L40); no damage type (unaffected by Affinities). FU damage.type has no 'none' unless the system provides one; fixed amount not HR-based.

spells.effect: You rip open a large portal to the Cosmos, calling down astral debris from the gaping void. Choose one option: you deal 60 damage to one enemy you can see; or you deal 40 damage to every enemy you can see. These amounts increase by 5 if you are level 20 or higher, or by 10 if you are level 40 or higher. Damage dealt by this spell has no type (thus being unaffected by damage Affinities).

spells.name: The Creeps
spells.effect: You may spend one action to conjure a terrifying Phantasm. Choose either weaken or shaken: the Phantasm inflicts the chosen status effect on the target hit by this spell. On any subsequent turn, you can perform an action and perform another Magic Check to use the Phantasm's ability again, spending only 5 MP.
spells.source: The Low Fantasy Atlas (Create Phantasm: Dread)

spells.name: The Heckler
spells.effect: You may spend one action to create a vexing Phantasm that taunts and distracts your foe. For the next Attack action, if the target rolls an even number for Accuracy Check, the attack misses. On any subsequent turn, you can perform an action and perform another Magic Check to use the Phantasm's ability again, spending only 5 MP.
spells.source: The Low Fantasy Atlas (Create Phantasm: Mockery)

spells.name: The Clout

damage._gap: Damage TYPE not stated — 'The range of the attack is determined by your current weapon'; damage type is likewise weapon-derived, not fixed on the spell. Value 12 (→16 at L20, 18 at L40).

spells.effect: You may spend one action to create a Phantasm and command it to attack a creature. The target hit by the Phantasm suffers (HR + 12) damage. This damage increases to 16 if you are level 20 or higher, or to 18 if you are level 40 or higher. The range of the attack is determined by your current weapon. On any subsequent turn, you can perform an action and perform another Magic Check to use the Phantasm's ability again, spending only 5 MP. Damage dealt by this spell ignores Resistances.
spells.source: The Low Fantasy Atlas (Create Phantasm: Strike)

spells.name: Gilding
spells.effect: You make a weapon appear as if it were imbued with soul energy. Choose a damage type: light or dark. Until this spell ends, all damage dealt by the weapon is of this type. If you have that weapon equipped while casting this spell, you may perform a free attack with it as part of the same action. This spell can only be cast on a weapon equipped by a willing creature.

spells.name: The Whip-Round
spells.effect: You command your Phantasms to replenish your allies' MP. Each Phantasm runs towards a companion and shatters itself in a spray of mana. Each target recovers 20 MP. A single ally cannot be replenished by more than one Phantasm per action.
spells.source: The Low Fantasy Atlas (Command: Essence Sacrifice)

spells.name: Patching
spells.effect: You command your Phantasms to heal your allies. Each Phantasm runs towards a companion and shatters itself in a cloud of healing energy. Each target recovers 20 HP. A single ally cannot be healed by more than one Phantasm per action.
spells.source: The Low Fantasy Atlas (Command: Vital Sacrifice)

spells.name: The Dazzle
spells.effect: You command all your active Phantasms to shatter with a blinding light. Choose either dazed or shaken: you inflict the chosen status effect on each target hit by this spell.
spells.source: The Low Fantasy Atlas (Command: Spectral Light)

spells.name: The Scatter
spells.effect: You command all your Phantasms to charge at your foes, shattering them on impact. They all share the same Magic Check. Each affected target suffers (HR + 15) physical damage. You can target only one foe per Phantasm. Damage dealt by this spell ignores Resistances.
spells.source: The Low Fantasy Atlas (Command: Multi Shatter)

spells.name: The Bang

damage._gap: Damage TYPE is a cast-time CHOICE: light or dark. Not a single fixed type.

spells.effect: You overflow one Phantasm with energy, making it explode to devastating effect. Choose a damage type: light or dark. The target hit by this spell suffers (HR + 25) damage of the chosen type. This shatters the Phantasm.
spells.source: The Low Fantasy Atlas (Command: Detonate Phantasm)

spells.name: The Double
spells.effect: When another creature is threatened by an attack, spell, or other danger, command one Phantasm to take their place. Any Checks that are part of the danger will be performed against the Phantasm. The Phantasm shields the creature from damage and status effects, shattering in the process.
spells.source: The Low Fantasy Atlas (Command: Illusory Shield)

spells.name: Grand Finale

damage._note: per-Phantasm scaling: (HR + 10) physical PER Phantasm (→15 at L20, 20 at L40); also inflicts dazed. Single damage.value cannot express the per-Phantasm multiplier.

spells.effect: You command all your active Phantasms to charge at a single enemy with incredible speed, shattering on impact. They all share a single Magic Check. If they hit, the target suffers (HR + 10) physical damage per Phantasm and dazed. Damage dealt by this spell ignores Resistances. This damage increases to 15 per Phantasm if you are level 20 or higher, or to 20 if you are level 40 or higher.
spells.source: The Low Fantasy Atlas (Command: Mirage Blitz — printed name retired ⛔)

spells.name: The Bottle
spells.effect: You create an illusion that makes your companions feel healthier and refreshed for a while. For their next 3 turns, they gain 40 additional HP — this increases both their maximum and their current HP by 40. This amount increases to 50 HP if you are level 20 or higher, or to 60 HP if you are level 40 or higher. After 3 turns, they lose this additional HP. If reduced to 0 HP at the end of the spell, the Sacrifice and Surrender rules apply as normal.

spells.name: The Prestige

damage._gap: Damage TYPE is chosen by Numen essence: Ravana=physical, Asura=light, Diablos=dark. Value 14 (→18 L20, 20 L40). ALSO a Heroic Skill (Create Phantasm: Numen), not a base spell — the draft (F3) flags it may belong in a heroics block, not spells.

spells.effect: You can now have up to 4 active Phantasms, but one of them must necessarily be Numen. ... When creating a Numen Phantasm, choose one essence, which dictates Numen's Damage Type: Ravana (Physical), Asura (Light), Diablos (Dark). The target hit by Numen suffers (HR + 14) damage. This damage increases to 18 if you are level 20 or higher, or to 20 if you are level 40 or higher. Damage dealt by Numen ignores Resistances and Immunities. The range of the attack is determined by your current weapon.
spells.source: The Low Fantasy Atlas (Create Phantasm: Numen — Illusionist Heroic Skill)
flags: Draft F3: labelled a HEROIC SKILL in source (own turn, HP = caster), structurally not a regular spell. Placement (spells vs heroics) is Compiler/Austin's call — effect text abridged here (full Numen special rules in the draft).

spells.name: Applied Infirmity
spells.effect: When you cast this spell, choose one status effect: dazed, shaken, slow, or weak. Each target hit by this spell suffers the chosen status effect.
spells.source: STELLA IMPULSUM — HOUSE FOLD of Halt/Stagger/Terrify/Wither (SPELLS-master-list §2E)
flags: House-authored effect text (documented fold), not PDF-verbatim; confirm wording against §2E.

spells.name: Reciprocal Transference
spells.effect: The targets swap their current status effects with one another. A willing target can choose to be hit by this spell regardless of the Magic Check's result.
flags: target 'Two creatures' — an uncommon FU target string; store verbatim.

spells.name: Nervous Debility
spells.effect: The target suffers a −1 penalty to their Accuracy or Magic Checks. This penalty increases to −2 if you are level 20 or higher, and to −3 if you are level 40 or higher.
flags: as-printed ambiguity: whether caster chooses Accuracy vs Magic, or both — left unresolved (needs ruling).

spells.name: Proscriptive Order

damage._note: HP loss = target's level when declared Action taken (untyped, not damage).

spells.effect: When you cast this spell, you must declare an Action type (besides Attack). For the spell's duration, whenever the target takes the declared Action, they lose Hit Points equal to their level. Once this has occurred 3 times, this spell's effects end.

spells.name: Humoral Transposition
spells.effect: The target's current Dexterity and Might die sizes are switched, as are their Insight and Willpower.

spells.name: Idiopathic Onset
spells.effect: Roll 1d6 once for every 10 Mind Points spent when casting this spell. Resolve each effect. 1: Nothing happens. 2: slow. 3: dazed. 4: weak. 5: shaken. 6: your choice of dazed, shaken, slow, or weak.

spells.name: Atavism
spells.effect: Any spells or effects on the target that were acquired since the end of your last turn are lost. If an effect was acquired as a consequence of a change of state, such as being in Crisis or holding a specific item, it cannot be lost as a result of this spell.

spells.name: Friability
spells.effect: When you cast this spell, name one damage type. The target is treated as Vulnerable to that damage type against the next source of damage it suffers, then this spell ends.
spells.source: STELLA IMPULSUM — HOUSE REWRITE of Soften (SPELLS-master-list §2D.2)
flags: House-authored effect text (documented rewrite), not PDF-verbatim; confirm against §2D.2.

spells.name: Structural Fatigue
spells.effect: The target's Defense and Magic Defense are each reduced by 2. Once the target has been hit by 3 Attacks or offensive spells, this spell's effect ends.

spells.name: Comprehensive Insult
spells.effect: You assault the target's body with a sensory onslaught. All stimuli, from pleasure to pain, light up at the same time. The target suffers dazed, enraged, poisoned, shaken, slow, and weak.
spells.source: STELLA IMPULSUM (Calamity) — learned via the Calamity Heroic Skill (must have mastered Malefactor)
flags: Offensive mismatch: source PDF marks it offensive; SPELLS-master-list §Malefactor(Heroic) Off? column reads '—'. Took the PDF (offensive) — consolidation should reconcile.

spells.name: Rusting
spells.effect: You imbue a weapon with poison and decay. Until this spell ends, all damage dealt by the weapon becomes of the poison type. If you have that weapon equipped while you cast this spell, you may perform a free attack with it as part of the same action. This spell can only be cast on a weapon equipped by a willing creature.

spells.name: Chalking

damage._note: amplifies a chosen type (+5 extra dmg + drain), no direct spell damage.

spells.effect: Choose a damage type: air, bolt, earth, fire, or ice. While the target is under the effect of this spell, if they suffer damage of the chosen type, they suffer 5 extra damage. Then, if that damage was caused by a creature, that creature recovers an amount of HP equal to half the total HP loss the target suffered. Once that happens, this spell ends.

spells.name: The Switch
spells.effect: Choose a damage type: air, bolt, earth, fire, or ice. Until this spell ends, all damage dealt by the creature becomes of the chosen type. Once that happens twice, this spell ends. This spell becomes offensive (◆) if its target is an enemy.
flags: CONDITIONAL offensive: only offensive if the target is an enemy. isOffensive set true; a boolean cannot capture the condition.

spells.name: Fester

damage._note: conditional: poisoned if NOT in Crisis, else (HR+30) poison damage. damage.value applies only in the Crisis branch.

spells.effect: You worsen the wounds of your enemy. The target suffers poisoned if they are not in Crisis, or (HR + 30) poison damage if they are in Crisis.

spells.name: Crosswind

damage._gap: TWO damage instances: (HR+5) air THEN (HR+5) ice. FU single damage field holds only one; the ice instance is unrepresented.

spells.effect: You weave magic from east to west, creating a storm. The target suffers (HR + 5) air damage, then suffers (HR + 5) ice damage

spells.name: The Left
spells.effect: Channel your negativity into an otherworldly attack. You may immediately perform a free attack with a melee weapon you have equipped. If you have two weapons equipped, you must use the one equipped in your off-hand slot. This attack may target creatures that you cannot see. If you used a weapon belonging to the arcane, dagger, or flail Category for this attack, it deals extra damage equal to (the total number of Inferiority, Mistrust, and/or Hatred emotions among your Bonds).

spells.name: The Pit

damage._gap: TWO damage instances: (HR+5) earth THEN (HR+5) fire. Second instance unrepresented in a single FU damage field.

spells.effect: You weave magic from north to south, erupting the earth below. The target suffers (HR + 5) earth damage, then suffers (HR + 5) fire damage

spells.name: On Tick
spells.effect: You relinquish some of your own energy to empower your companions. Each target recovers 30 MP. This amount increases to 35 MP if you are level 20 or higher, or to 40 MP if you are level 40 or higher. If this spell's HP cost becomes 0, is removed, and/or is unpaid, the MP recovery is halved.

spells.name: The Particular
spells.opportunity: Targets hit by this spell suffer poisoned
spells.effect: You conjure a thick, toxic fog. Each target hit by this spell suffers (HR + 15) poison damage. Opportunity: Targets hit by this spell suffer poisoned.

spells.name: Shoring
spells.effect: The next time the target suffers damage, that damage is halved (before applying Affinities). If the target is in Crisis, it suffers no damage instead. Once this happens, this spell ends.

spells.name: The Draw

damage._note: MP loss = total HP cost of this spell (or +10 if target in Crisis).

spells.effect: The darkness inside you beckons to another. The target loses an amount of MP equal to (the total HP cost of this spell), or (10 + the total HP cost of this spell) if they are in Crisis.

spells.name: Rot
spells.effect: You command your foe's body to wilt and wither. The target suffers (HR + 25) poison damage. Damage dealt by this spell ignores Resistances.

spells.name: The Knot
spells.effect: You tie your well-being to that of another. Until this spell ends, if the target would be reduced to 0 HP, you may instead set their current HP equal to your own. If you do, you must immediately Surrender or Sacrifice yourself. If you are reduced to 0 HP by any other method, the target loses an amount of HP equal to your Crisis score.

spells.name: The Four Winds

damage._gap: FIXED multi-type: 10 earth, then 10 ice, then 10 fire, then 10 air to every enemy, then (10 + Inferiority/Mistrust/Hatred bond count) of a CHOSEN type. Five sequential fixed instances + a chosen-type instance — not representable in one FU damage field.

spells.effect: You call on magic from deep within the ley lines... Every enemy you can see suffers 10 earth damage, then 10 ice damage, then 10 fire damage, then 10 air damage. Finally, those enemies suffer (10 + the total number of Inferiority, Mistrust, and/or Hatred emotions among your Bonds) damage of the type you chose.
flags: source header prints 'MP: 50' but rendered 50 HP (Magic of the Craft costs HP).

spells.name: Prophylactic Aegis
spells.effect: You project your soul outside your body and direct it to surround the targets, shielding them from dangerous magic. Until this spell ends, each target may treat their Magic Defense score as being equal to 12 (they may still use their normal Magic Defense score if it is higher than 12). This value increases to 13 if you are level 20 or higher, or to 14 if you are level 40 or higher.

spells.name: Tonic Excitation
spells.effect: You allow a creature to focus their vital energy into accomplishing what they previously could not. Choose one Attribute: Dexterity, Insight, Might, or Willpower. Until this spell ends, the target treats the chosen Attribute as if it were one die size higher (up to a maximum of d12).

spells.name: Refractory Palisade
spells.effect: You project your soul outside your body and weave it into a barrier to protect the targets from attacks. Until this spell ends, each target may treat their Defense score as being equal to 12 (they may still use their normal Defense score if it is higher than 12). This value increases to 13 if you are level 20 or higher, or to 14 if you are level 40 or higher.

spells.name: Depurative Regimen
spells.effect: You strengthen and purify the soul energy coursing through your companions. Each target recovers from all status effects.

spells.name: Choleric Provocation
spells.effect: You cause a creature to lose any semblance of temper and act brazenly. The target suffers enraged and cannot perform the Guard or Spell actions until the end of their next turn.

spells.name: Delusive Impression
spells.effect: You alter the senses of your enemies, causing them to experience bizarre or frightening hallucinations. Choose dazed or shaken: each target hit by this spell suffers the chosen status effect.

spells.name: General Restoration
spells.effect: You invigorate your companions, soothing their pain and easing their fatigue. Each target recovers 40 Hit Points. This amount increases to 50 Hit Points if you are level 20 or higher, or to 60 Hit Points if you are level 40 or higher.

spells.name: Luminous Cautery
spells.opportunity: each target hit by this spell suffers dazed
spells.effect: You focus your inner energy into a barrage of blinding soul rays. You deal (HR + 15) light damage to each target hit by this spell. Opportunity: each target hit by this spell suffers dazed.

spells.name: Aldworth's Compress
spells.effect: You strengthen the heart of a creature against suffering and despair. Until this spell ends, if the target is reduced to 0 Hit Points, they are instead left standing with exactly 1 Hit Point. Once that happens, this spell ends.

spells.name: Acquired Tolerance
spells.effect: You protect the targets from attacks that would corrupt their body and spirit. Choose dazed, enraged, poisoned, shaken, slow, or weak. Until this spell ends, each target is immune to the chosen status effect.

spells.name: Anodyne Mantle
spells.effect: You weave energy to safeguard the targets. Choose a damage type: dark, light, or poison. Until this spell ends, each target gains Resistance to the chosen damage type.

spells.name: Actinic Plating
spells.effect: You imbue a weapon with the cleansing energy of your spirit. Until this spell ends, all damage dealt by the weapon becomes light. If you have that weapon equipped while you cast this spell, you may perform a free attack with it as part of the same action. This spell can only be cast on a weapon equipped by a willing creature.

spells.name: Attenuative Draught
spells.effect: You smother the soul energy coursing through the bodies of your foes, hindering their movements. Choose slow or weak: each target hit by this spell suffers the chosen status effect.

spells.name: Resuscitative Office
spells.effect: You rekindle the flames of courage and hope within a defeated hero. Choose a Player Character who Surrendered but is still narratively present on the scene: that Player Character immediately regains consciousness and recovers an amount of Hit Points equal to their Crisis score. ... A Player Character may only be affected by this spell once per scene. ...
spells.source: Core Rulebook v1.1 (Hope, heroic spell p.236)
flags: Heroic-skill spell (part of the HOPE heroic), not a Spiritual-Magic learnable spell — placement is Compiler/Austin's call.

spells.name: Antiphonal Relief
spells.effect: You call upon the spirits to join you in song and reinvigorate your allies' spirits. Until this spell ends, each target that is about to pay a Mind Point cost may halve that cost. Then, the effects of this spell ends for that target. This spell cannot be cast on a creature benefiting from the Massage Camp Activity (see Natural Fantasy Atlas, page 133), and its benefit cannot be applied to a Ritual's cost in Mind Points. This spell is treated as a verse for the purposes of Chanter Skills...
flags: source has a cross-reference to Natural Fantasy Atlas p.133 and a printed typo "allies's" — flagged in draft for Austin; typo normalized to allies' here pending ruling.

dances.note: NOT modeled as spells. The Dancer casts no spells and appears in no spell register (CLASSREF-dancer.md). The DANCE skill lets you pick one of 17 dances. Each dance has ONLY a name, a duration, and an effect — NO mpCost, NO target, NO isOffensive. Durations are 'Until the start of your next turn' or 'Instantaneous'; the former is NOT in the FU spell duration enum. STRUCTURAL DATA GAP: dances do not fit the FU spell-Item shape. Needs a god/Austin ruling: model as a different item type (a class feature/effect), or extend the spell shape. Listed here verbatim so the data isn't lost.

items.name: Angel Dance
items.duration: Until the start of your next turn
items.effect: Choose one option: you gain Resistance to light damage; or all damage dealt by your attacks and spells becomes light.

items.name: Banshee Dance
items.effect: Choose another creature that is able to see you. If that creature is suffering from slow, they suffer shaken.

items.name: Bat Dance
items.duration: Until the start of your next turn
items.effect: Choose one option: you gain Resistance to dark damage; or all damage dealt by your attacks and spells becomes dark.

items.name: Golem Dance
items.duration: Until the start of your next turn
items.effect: Choose one option: you gain Resistance to bolt damage; or all damage dealt by your attacks and spells becomes bolt.

items.name: Griffin Dance
items.duration: Until the start of your next turn
items.effect: Choose one option: you gain Resistance to air damage; or all damage dealt by your attacks and spells becomes air.

items.name: Hydra Dance
items.duration: Until the start of your next turn
items.effect: After you suffer damage, choose one option: you recover 5 Hit Points, or you recover 5 Mind Points.

items.name: Kraken Dance
items.effect: Choose another creature that is able to see you. If that creature is suffering from dazed, they suffer slow.

items.name: Lion Dance
items.effect: You recover from a single status effect of your choice.

items.name: Maenad Dance
items.effect: Choose another creature that is able to see you. That creature loses an amount of Mind Points equal to your current Dexterity die size.

items.name: Myrmidon Dance
items.duration: Until the start of your next turn
items.effect: Choose one option: you gain Resistance to earth damage; or all damage dealt by your attacks and spells becomes earth.

items.name: Nightmare Dance
items.effect: Choose another creature that is able to see you. If that creature is suffering from shaken, they suffer weak.

items.name: Ouroboros Dance
items.effect: Choose one ally you can see that has yet to take a turn during this round. That ally may take their turn immediately after yours during this round.

items.name: Peacock Dance
items.effect: Choose another creature that is able to see you. The next time that creature performs an attack or casts an offensive spell (O) during this scene, that attack or spell must include you among its targets if possible.

items.name: Phoenix Dance
items.duration: Until the start of your next turn
items.effect: Choose one option: you gain Resistance to fire damage; or all damage dealt by your attacks and spells becomes fire.

items.name: Satyr Dance
items.effect: Choose another creature that is able to see you. If that creature is suffering from weak, they suffer dazed.

items.name: Unicorn Dance
items.effect: Choose an ally that is able to see you and has a Bond towards you: you and that ally both recover an amount of Hit Points equal to your current Dexterity die size. The restored amount increases by 5 Hit Points if you are level 20 or higher, or by 10 Hit Points if you are level 40 or higher.

items.name: Yeti Dance
items.duration: Until the start of your next turn
items.effect: Choose one option: you gain Resistance to ice damage; or all damage dealt by your attacks and spells becomes ice.

npc_spells.note: GM NPC-design toolkit (Core Rulebook pp.310–311), NOT class spells and NOT guise-stampable. Each is deliberately customizable — 'choose type'/'choose status' placeholders mean damage type and status are UNRESOLVED by design (the GM picks when building an NPC). Included for completeness; excluded from class_spells. Offensive marker 'O' preserved.

items.name: Area Status
items.effect: Every enemy the NPC can see suffers (choose one: dazed, shaken, slow, weak).

items.name: Breath
items.effect: The NPC deals (HR + 10) (choose type) damage to the target.

items.name: Curse
items.effect: The target suffers (choose one: dazed, shaken, slow, weak).

items.name: Curse XL
items.effect: The target suffers (choose two: dazed, shaken, slow, weak).

items.name: Cursed Breath
items.effect: The NPC deals (HR + 15) (choose type) damage to the target, then the target suffers (choose one: dazed, shaken, slow, weak).

items.name: Devastation
items.effect: The NPC deals 30 (choose type) damage to every enemy they can see. (Champion/elite L30+ only; last turn of round.)

items.name: Lick Wounds
items.effect: The NPC recovers 20 Hit Points (30 at L20, 40 at L40, 50 at L60).

items.name: Life Theft
items.effect: The NPC deals (HR + 15) (choose type) damage, then recovers HP equal to half the total HP loss suffered by the target.

items.name: Mind Theft
items.effect: The NPC deals (HR + 15) (choose type) damage, then recovers MP equal to half the total HP loss suffered by the target.

items.name: Poison
items.effect: Each target hit by this spell suffers poisoned.

items.name: Quicken
items.effect: The target may perform a free attack with a weapon they have equipped (or a basic attack, if an NPC).

items.name: Rage
items.effect: Each target hit by this spell suffers enraged.

items.name: Shell
items.effect: Until this spell ends, the NPC gains Resistance to physical damage.

items.name: War Cry
items.effect: Until this spell ends, each target gains a +1 bonus to Accuracy Checks.

items.name: Weaken
items.effect: Until this spell ends, sources that deal (choose type) damage deal 5 extra damage to the target.

vivisectionist.note: NO static spell list. The Vivisectionist (Chimerist) learns spells at RUNTIME via Spell Mimic (SL10): after a beast/monster/plant casts and resolves a spell, it may learn that spell (no MP/action/Check), capped at (SL+2) memorized, recording the source Species (RULE-spell-mimic-cost.md). There is no fixed catalog to stamp — its spells are player-acquired in play. Flagged so guise auto-stamp does NOT expect a Vivisectionist spell list.
